_about: Add-on API 1.7: how deep the character's named points sit (scripts/player/character_points.gd), per look, in tiles. back and chest: out from the spine's middle, behind and in front; eyes: forward from the head bone at eye_height (0 the neck, 1 the top); hip: out from each thigh's head. Measured from the models' vertices (the outermost within 0.1 of the centre line), just outside the surface. A look not listed gets defaults worked out from its bones.
